title: PILLAGERS DROP BETTER GEAR
why: His note of 2026-10-09: gear that drops from enemies dying needs to be better. A dead pillager left what he had looted, mostly bandages, ammo, wire and boards, plus his gun. Every body now also carries one roll from the best loot table (cores, titanium, optics, plates, medkits and real guns), and one in a medium or heavy rig a second, so the fight pays like the loot it guards. The map is unchanged.
now: Dead pillagers now drop better gear: an extra high value item, two from a man in medium or heavy armour.

edits.replacement:
_drop=_drop.concat(bodyBonus(e));   // v16.xx, his note: what a pillager drops is better
        var c=setLoot(mkContainer(e.x,e.y,'body'),_drop); G.containers.push(c);
